_readme: Copy to infra/private/<staging|prod>.json (git ignored) and fill every value. Fake values below. Passwords: 32 hex characters each (openssl rand -hex 16), so they never need escaping in a URL. Keep a copy where a teammate can reach it (infra/RUNBOOK.md names where).

auth.signingKeys: {"keys":[...]} from npm run keys:rotate in welinc-auth, one fresh set per environment
auth.smtpPass: the Brevo SMTP key for this environment

clients.vrms: public JWK set from npm run keys:client vrms (yours)

vrms.clientPrivateKey: private JWK from the same npm run keys:client vrms run

sentry._readme: VRMS spec 0025: each project's DSN from Sentry (Project settings, Client Keys). Public values; blank turns Sentry off for that app. vrmsWeb and portal both or neither (the gateway tunnels). The same two browser DSNs go in the web repos' SENTRY_DSN_VRMS_WEB and SENTRY_DSN_PORTAL variables.

vmms-backend.SOME_SECRET: sent privately by the VMMS group

bms-booking.BMS_INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY: sent privately by the BMS group
